name: Aurix International
author: ZaheerAbbas
description: Custom WooCommerce theme for Aurix International — surgical and dental instruments.
changelog: v36.102.0 — Inbox app redesign + notifications: phone notifications for new messages and access requests (Web Push, works when the app is closed; iPhone after Add to Home Screen), notification on/off + "important only" + test in Settings; "Install app" card and Settings row that hide once installed (iPhone step-by-step guide); bottom tab bar (Inbox, Unread, Team, Settings); messages grouped by day; swipe right = Done, left = Archive with Undo; pull to refresh; message screen with "What they want" card, copy buttons, chat-style conversation, sticky Call/WhatsApp/Reply/Note/Done bar, reply sheet with quick replies; Team tab to accept/decline requests on the phone; offline screen; branded PNG app icons. v36.101.0 — Inbox access requests: scanning the Inbox QR shows a "Request access" form; the request appears on the Inbox dashboard to Accept or Decline (admins also get an email). Once accepted, the phone opens the Inbox by itself. Team members are now limited to the Inbox app only — no WordPress admin, profile, orders, products or settings; they stay signed in for 60 days and can sign out from the app. v36.100.0 — Inbox team access: admins give staff Inbox-only access (new "Inbox Team" role — no orders, products or settings). Each person gets a personal QR code / link (one-time, 48 h) that signs them in on their phone without a password; email or WhatsApp the link; remove access signs them out everywhere. "Open on phone" QR on the Inbox dashboard. Only admins can delete messages. QR codes generated locally. v36.99.0 — Inbox mobile app at /inbox-app/: phone-first message list with filters and search, one-tap Call / WhatsApp / Reply / Email, quick-reply templates, status buttons, live new-message check and home-screen install (app icon + unread badge). QR code on Inbox → Settings to open it on your phone. v36.98.1 — Inbox: import Pioneer Program applications (Offer Codes Manager) with the customer's name, email, phone and code status; Kit Builder quotes import shows kit items as a readable list; plugin emails sent by logged-in customers use their account details. v36.98.0 — New unified Inbox (WP Admin → Inbox): every message in one place — distributor signups, Pioneer/offer code applications, wholesale quotes, Kit Builder RFQs, contact form, product questions, newsletter, VIP waitlist, back-in-stock alerts and supplier listings. Clear type labels and a plain-English "what they want" line, reply by email from inside WordPress, internal notes, statuses, search, CSV export, unread badge and dashboard widget. Plugin notification emails are captured automatically; one-click import of existing waitlist, stock-alert, supplier and plugin data. New [aurix_newsletter] shortcode.
